criteria.text: Summary generation obtains snapshot/parent metadata without materializing historical message bodies, tool outputs, attachment bytes, or prior summary patches. Normal session and per-user summary counts remain correct.
criteria.test_id: issue-1603-c1: summary counts and user diff persist without hydrating historical messages

criteria.text: Repeated overlapping summary requests for a session coalesce into bounded work, retaining the final relevant update; failure/cancellation does not permanently block a later summary.
criteria.test_id: issue-1603-c2: overlapping summary requests coalesce and a failed worker allows retry

criteria.text: Snapshot diff construction checks object sizes before reading content, bounds per-file and aggregate patch construction, preserves normal small-file patches and correct file counts/status for omitted oversized patches, and exposes omission honestly rather than silently claiming complete patch text.
criteria.test_id: issue-1603-c3: diffFull preserves small exact patches and counts while explicitly omitting oversized content

criteria.text: A deterministic regression reproduces the pre-fix amplification at a safe scale and passes with the repair; existing affected summary/snapshot/session tests and typechecking pass.
criteria.test_id: issue-1603-c4: safe scale multi-file diff remains within the aggregate patch budget

criteria.text: An env-gated live behavioral test runs against the real API and fork inside tools/dev/sandbox.sh with synthetic data, proving summaries remain bounded and health remains responsive. Record peak process memory, exact commands and teardown.
criteria.test_id: issue-1603-c5: real turn retains bounded diffs, correct counts, and responsive health

scope_note: Focused candidate verification; final integrated CI and installed delivery remain separate.
